verdict.rationale: Fastmail offers a public JMAP API, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows only static documentation: a developer page pointing to the IETF RFCs, a session-discovery endpoint, and prose snippets on jmap.io. Nothing shows an interactive explorer or runnable examples, and probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec that could power one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
